Restore the Cully panel's native usage instruments after the status-line removal:

- **Codex:** request model, context, input/output tokens and available quotas for the wrapped child when no custom footer is configured.
- **Claude Code:** restore the live native usage callback inside `cully run claude`. Keep saved settings unchanged and preserve an existing user status-line command.
- **Cursor:** display the model reported by native hooks and label the context percentage/token sample reported before compaction. Clear that historical sample on later activity; input/output totals and quotas remain unavailable when Cursor does not report them.

Callbacks are isolated to the live pane and primary native session. Missing/null measurements clear stale usage, and late or foreign callbacks cannot populate another session. Regression and CLI pseudo-terminal tests cover all three agents, native-setting preservation and session boundaries.

Update the CLI with `cully update`, then start a new Cully terminal session. For Cursor's new `preCompact` hook, rerun `cully setup` with your original options. Explicit Codex footer overrides and Claude project/CLI status-line settings remain authoritative; they can opt out of the injected usage feed. Direct native agent launches keep their existing configuration.
